title: The Maharashtra Drinking Water Supply Requisition Act, 1983.
full_text: The Maharashtra Drinking Water Supply Requisition Act, 1983. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198320 Act Number: 20 Enactment Date: 1983-04-15 Act Year: 1983 Short Title: The Maharashtra Drinking Water Supply Requisition Act, 1983. Ministry: Ministry of Govt Of Maharashtra Department: Water Supply And Sanitation Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. During Scarcity, power to order supply of water to public for drinking purposes from any well. Section 4. Guidelines for making order to supply water from any well. Section 5. Power to obtain information and enter any land for determining whether water should be supplied from any well. Section 6. When order is made for supply of water, right to enter land for obtaining such supply. Section 7. When order is made for supply of water powers to provide apparatus or machinery or water-pipes. Section 8. Amount payable to owner for utilisation of water from his well. Section 9. Appeals. Section 10. Protection of action taken under Act. Section 11. Power to make rules. Section 12. Exemptions. Section 13. Repeal of Mah. Ord. V of 1983 and saving. Section 14. Removal of difficulties.
